title: Failed Maxx Crosby trade prompted Giants, Bengals to get Dexter Lawrence deal done early

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Failed Maxx Crosby trade prompted Giants, Bengals to get Dexter Lawrence deal done early
sources.description: Ideally, the Giants would have acquired the Bengals' first-round pick in exchange for defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence when the pick was on the clock.
